summary: IPinfo is a REST API for IP intelligence: geolocation, ASN, network flags (anonymous, hosting, anycast, mobile, satellite), and more. It has a free Lite tier and paid Core/Plus/Max tiers, plus a batch endpoint and downloadable databases.

sources.quote: IPinfo Lite uses the api.ipinfo.io API URL and /lite endpoint.
A Bearer token in the Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN)

value.description: HTTP Basic with the token as username and an empty password.

sources.quote: HTTP Basic Authentication (using the token as the username, e.g. curl -u $TOKEN:)

value.description: API token passed as a token query parameter.

value.purpose: Free lookup returning country, continent and ASN data. Use 'me' for the caller's IP.
Paid (Core/Plus/Max) lookup: geolocation, ASN and network flags.

access.requirement: Paid tier (Core/Plus/Max); free tokens get an error

source.quote: since /lookup is a paid-tier endpoint and will return an error on free tokens.

value.purpose: Return a single field as plaintext (e.g. country_code, asn).
Group up to 1,000 lookups (IPs or URL patterns like lite/<ip>, resproxy/<ip>, <asn>) in one request; default lookup is /lookup.

keyParams.name: body
keyParams.description: JSON array, newline- or space-separated list of IPs/URL patterns

sources.quote: The /batch API endpoint lets you group up to 1,000 IPinfo API requests into a single HTTP request.

value.purpose: Batch lookups for free-tier users (country, continent, ASN).

sources.quote: The /lite endpoint is available to all users, both free and paid tier.

value.purpose: Legacy API response shape for existing customers.

value.limits: Lite unlimited; paid plans have a monthly request quota; no daily/hourly caps, no concurrency limits, no per-second throttling on paid plans.
value.description: Exceeding the plan limit returns HTTP 429 unless metered billing (overages) is enabled.

sources.quote: If you exceed your plan's limit, you'll receive a 429 HTTP status code.

value.description: No version number; the 'updated' schema is on api.ipinfo.io (/lite, /lookup) and the older schema is on ipinfo.io (legacy).

versioning.reasoning: Docs describe an updated API on api.ipinfo.io and a legacy API on ipinfo.io with a different response shape, but no versioning policy.

risks.title: Two response schemas
risks.detail: Updated (api.ipinfo.io) and legacy (ipinfo.io) shapes differ (nested geo/as vs flat city/loc); pick one deliberately.

risks.title: Token in query string
risks.detail: The token is commonly shown as a query parameter, which can leak into logs; prefer the Bearer header server-side.

risks.title: Error format undocumented
risks.detail: The fetched pages don't describe error bodies; only 429 and 'error on free tokens' are mentioned.

risks.title: Tier gating
risks.detail: /lookup is paid-only; free tokens must use /lite.

risks.title: Batch size
risks.detail: Batches are limited to 1,000 items per request.

openQuestions: What is the JSON error body format and the full list of status codes?
